response.rationale: The order is still in "processing" status and has not been delivered (days_since_delivery is null), so no delivery-window rule can be satisfied. The standard return window rules (RET-007/RET-008) require a delivery to have occurred; RET-007 cannot apply because days_since_delivery is not a value <= 30. No higher-priority rule applies: final_sale is false (RET-012 excluded), defective is not True (RET-020 excluded), and neither goodwill_grant nor fraud_hold is set. Since the item has not been delivered, there is no eligible-return basis and the request cannot be granted at this time.
